description: React component for managing and displaying license and edition settings in the Mattermost admin console, including license upload, removal, upgrade, and license status display.

classes.name: LicenseSettings
classes.description: React component class for license management in Mattermost admin console, handling license upload, removal, upgrade, and display.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data fetch and setup when component mounts, including license config and user stats.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles modal opening when a new license file is selected.

methods.name: openEELicenseModal
methods.description: Opens modal to input enterprise edition license.

methods.name: confirmLicenseRemoval
methods.description: Opens modal to confirm license removal.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes current license and refreshes license info.

methods.name: checkRestarted
methods.description: Checks server restart status and reloads page.

methods.name: handleRestart
methods.description: Restarts server and reloads page upon success.

methods.name: setClickNormalUpgradeBtn
methods.description: Sets state indicating normal upgrade button was clicked.

methods.name: currentPlan
methods.description: JSX element displaying current plan label.

methods.name: termsAndPolicy
methods.description: JSX element with links to terms of service and privacy policy.

methods.name: comparePlans
methods.description: JSX element linking to plan comparison page if not entry SKU.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the license settings UI, including panels and banners.

methods.name: renewLicenseCard
methods.description: Returns JSX for license renewal or trial license card.
